## About
Angkor Collision Auto Body Repair and Paint of San Jose fixes all types of collision damage. Our repair center includes framework measuring equipment, and our team is made up of highly trained technicians.
We only use parts from reputable brands, and we want you to leave safe and happy with the work done on your car. Drivers have given us a 4.7 rating on Google from 35 reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repair for all types of collision damage, big or small.
- Dent and paint work: Body and paint repair to get your car looking right again. One reviewer said their car looked brand new afterward.
- Framework measuring: Our repair center includes framework measuring equipment.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of damage do you repair?
A: We handle all types of collision damage, including dent and paint work.

Q: What happens if original parts aren't available?
A: One reviewer said that when OEM parts were not available, we used the highest quality aftermarket parts and explained the difference to them.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 1695 Angela St in San Jose, CA 95125.
